title: This Is Where Bounces Get Born.
speaker: Figuring Out Money host

macro_themes.view: Below the gamma flip (~7724 SPX) and the Nasdaq 10-day MA, so expect fakeouts and shakeouts: trade smaller and be patient.
High-beta momentum names are down ~40% while the S&P holds near highs; retail without risk management is hurting.
Weak breadth and extreme quality-pair / record-high readings have historically come near bounces.

calls.condition: Wants the declining 5-day MA to flatten and turn up with higher lows before turning bullish; daily expected move up to ~771, gap-fill support at 762
calls.reason: Index products are below declining 5-day MAs and weak internals call for caution, but oversold breadth and quality-pair extremes favor bounces.
calls.quote: it looks like we can be setting up for some bounces... As far as the index products go, they're below declining 5-day moving averages

calls.condition: If the 5-day MA flattens and a 30-min inverse head-and-shoulders forms, it could try for 745
calls.reason: Clear downtrend since Oct 9, but a positive 30-min RSI divergence and a possible inverse H&S.
calls.quote: we come to try to take out that 745

calls.condition: If the 5-day MA flattens and price gets above it, that opens a move higher
calls.reason: Repeatedly rejected at a declining 5-day MA; needs patience.
calls.quote: perhaps that opens the door for a move higher in IWM. But once again, it's not there yet.

calls.condition: Sideways action that flattens and reclaims the 5-day MA would be an early bounce signal
calls.reason: Hard, fast selling since Oct 7 and a close at session lows, but oversold shakeouts could lead to bounces.
calls.quote: those could be early indications that we can see a bounce here in semiconductors

notes: Host name not given. ES medium-term bullish is inferred from his breadth and bottoming indicators (low conviction). The 7724 gamma flip is an SPX level, while 771/762 are SPY.
